summary: No new role cleared every hard gate. Anthropic's hands-on Paris Forward Deployed Engineer opening does not publish numerical base pay; its Enterprise and Partnerships roles have advisory/pre-sales scope and compensation that is not confirmed cash base. DualEntry's Applied Engineer and Photoroom's Senior Backend Engineer primarily build integrations and pricing, not AI systems. Escape's previously selected research role has no numerical salary floor on the current listing. All six entries are research leads, not recommendations.
coverage: 16 official Ashby boards retrieved from 20 attempted board aliases, plus Anthropic's official Greenhouse board and web discovery. Six individual roles examined in detail, with six rendered application forms: three Anthropic Paris roles, DualEntry Applied Engineer, Photoroom Senior Backend Engineer and an Escape research-role recheck. Board screening is discovery, not individual verification of every vacancy. Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; a technical title or an AI employer does not establish the required work scope.
Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Equity is not cash; OTE, packages, estimates and upper bounds do not pass.
No unchanged previously reported selections. Requisition identity takes precedence over refreshed titles, timestamps or URLs; historical qualification is not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Evidence checked October 16, 2026. Posting dates come from employer ATS publication metadata, not a claim that these jobs were first discovered or created today.

Four attempted Ashby aliases returned 404; this does not establish the employers have no vacancies. Anthropic was instead retrieved through its actual Greenhouse board. The extraction service was unavailable; direct official retrieval and browser rendering were used. Web discovery used a fallback search backend.

Anthropic's Paris pages explicitly publish a location-based hybrid policy with at least 25% office attendance; the board's separate Location Type metadata says On-Site. The published minimum is recorded, not a guarantee of a particular weekly schedule or an upper attendance limit.

Anthropic's Enterprise and Partnerships pages show annual compensation figures but also an OTE disclaimer for sales roles, without a cash-base breakdown. These figures are not represented as verified annual base pay.

DualEntry's original USD annual base range is retained without a EUR eligibility comparison. No positive pay decision is made because AI-primary work and explicit France eligibility are unresolved or failed. Photoroom's shorthand 95k to 105k does not specify currency, annual basis or gross base, so those attributes remain unknown.

Deduplication covers accessible October 10–15 reports, October 14–15 board snapshots and supplied earlier selection history. Original October 3 and 5 reports were not accessible in this checkout; complete historical deduplication is not claimed. Escape, Pigment and DualEntry's prior Senior AI Engineer selection were not recycled.

No role advanced to separate product/company diligence. Funding, current financial condition, total employee size and recent material activity are not publicly verified in this run. Listing descriptions below are attributed role context, not independent product verification.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. No newly qualifying application is recommended. Any follow-up on a near-miss should first establish qualifying annual gross cash-base terms and resolve its other stated gates. No applications or outreach were made.
